column1: # Coined Persian terms that a Persian-speaking engineer would say in English.
# One rule per line: pattern <TAB> English term <TAB> scope.
# pattern: a Python regex for the Persian word (Persian suffixes such as ‌ها، ‌های، ی، ‌ای are matched automatically).
# scope: * (every Persian book), TECH (the technical books), DIST (storage and distributed-systems books), or comma-separated book slugs.
# scripts/validate.py fails on any match in a Persian note, README, framework, widget or lab README; scripts/fa_terms.py --fix rewrites them.
# Longer phrases come first, so they win over the single words inside them.
